slip-intro: Swipe the water. Every crab slides until something stops it.
slip-help: Swipe up, down, left or right. Every crab slides that way until a wall, a rock or another crab stops it. A crab that reaches its own pool goes home. Undo and Reset are free, so try anything.
slip-hint-look: Look at this crab. It gets home first.
slip-hint-think: See what stops it, right there.
slip-stuck: These crabs cannot get home from here. Undo or Reset, and nothing is lost.
slip-together: Each person has two arrows. Talk it through.
